title: Open the PR that lands the digichat publish probe fix and the release-ledger correction on develop
description:
Merge-captain ask (orphan branch, DevOps Lead seat rule: 0 own PRs).

Branch: DIG-4485-publish-digichat-2-5-0-and-complete-the-main-promotion-steps
Head sha: 9c9e5c0e230e58617ae01e390cc3289866990fe5 (pushed to the github remote; base develop, 0 behind / 5 ahead of github/develop)

What is in the branch, in order:
1. 5681e4b05 - release ledger row for digichat v2.5.0.
2. e03c69877 - merge of github/develop (clears BEHIND, which is in the queue's STALE_MERGE_STATES).
3. 8b68f76909 - the publish-lane probe fix, one line in scripts/local-deploy/publish_image.sh: the digichat probe container now runs with '-e DIGICHAT_ENABLED_SERVICES=' (set and empty). getEnabledServiceIds() falls back to all four services only when the variable is undefined, so an unset variable made /api/health answer 503 (digraph/digisearch/digiquant/digitrace unreachable) and the publish aborted. With it set and empty, the four checks are vacuously true, checks.database is 'skipped' and /api/health returns 200 with the image's own version. bash -n clean.
4. 4c21bce13 - release ledger rows for v2.5.1 and a new section 'GHCR: what is actually published (measured 2026-10-21)', including the correction that 'ghcr.io/digithings-ai/digichat:sha-3e3c384c1ea3' was never published (manifest unknown) - the publish lane refuses to push a rehearsal ':sha-*' image.
5. 9c9e5c0e23 - merge of github/develop (the ledger file conflicted with the OCC lane's 2.6.x trial rows; resolved by keeping both sides).

Why it matters: without 8b68f76909 the local publish lane cannot publish any digichat image, and the GitHub publish workflow uses the same script, so every future publish fails the same way. The ledger correction records that no digichat image was published to GHCR for any 2.4.x, 2.5.x or 2.6.x tag until 2026-10-21.

Overlap to watch: DIG-4505 (Repo, CI & Release Engineer) also edits scripts/local-deploy/publish_image.sh (multi-line tags output, commit f64e8cef66, not on develop yet). Merge develop in before merging, so both land.

Done when: the PR is merged into develop. The branch is pushed and mergeable; no rebasing is needed by the owner.

ancestors.title: Publish digichat 2.5.0 and complete the main promotion steps
ancestors.description:
The `digichat-v2.5.0` release exists and the OCC chat is live on the split worker (PR #5940 merged 2026-10-19, merge commit a9bf1b9117; tag `digichat-v2.5.0` on that commit; `apps/digichat/package.json` reads 2.5.0 at the tag). Three release-process steps are human-owned and are NOT done:

1. **Publish the image to GHCR** — `ghcr.io/digithings-ai/digichat:v2.5.0`. The GitHub publish workflow is disabled (Actions minutes exhausted), and the local lane `scripts/local-deploy/publish_image.sh digichat --tag digichat-v2.5.0 --push` needs a GHCR login plus `LOCAL_DEPLOY_APPROVED_BY` naming Chris for a release. The Cloudflare/OCC path is NOT blocked by this: that deploy builds its container locally, and it is live (health 200, version 2.5.0, container id shared-a9bf1b9117be).
2. **Promote develop -> main** — a human owns that cutover (Chris's approval through One). Nothing was pushed to main.
3. **Cut the `release/v2.5.0` branch** from main at the promotion commit, per RELEASES.md. It must be cut from main, not from develop, and it must never be merged back into main.

Also outstanding, and deliberately not done in this release: the **visitor model picker stays closed for the OCC tenant** (its tenant config carries no `models`/`allowPicker` axis, and the served page keeps `[data-deploy-model-picker] { display: none !important; }`). Before anyone enables it for this client, the provider slugs in the stack's `DIGI_SESSION_MODEL_ALLOWLIST` must be cleared against the client's subprocessor/DPA list — that is a separate owner (Security & Risk / Counsel), tracked on its own issue.

DoD note: the release ledger entry for 2.5.0 is still to be written by the release owner.

ancestors.title: OCC chat: reconcile the pre-Cloudflare improvements, cut a new digichat release, and restore the working chat
ancestors.description:
## Chris's ask (verbatim intent)

> "This is sensitive work for a client and I need it as soon as possible... get it back to its original state with the current worker stack separate from the original but back to the same versions and fix the UI and all that because the clean way to do that is to actually have a new digichat release we should do that with all the latest."

OCC (Online Compliance Center) chat is **live and half-working**. It is client-facing, invite-gated, and in active use. Restore it to the functional state it had around **2026-10-14/15**, but on the **new split worker** (OCC no longer rides the base digithings platform), by cutting a **new digichat release** that carries every OCC improvement made on the release branch.

Run this task on **claude-opus-5-5 at high effort** (the seat is already configured for that). Do not hand it to a smaller model.

---

## Where things live

- Repo: `/Users/chrisstefan/Code/digithings` (remote `github` = `digithings-ai/digithings`).
- **Work already started for you** — branch `DIG-OCC-reconcile`, commit `af9c483dd`, pushed to `github`:
  `https://github.com/digithings-ai/digithings/tree/DIG-OCC-reconcile`
  Worktree: `/Users/chrisstefan/Code/digithings/.worktrees/occ-reconcile` (has `npm ci` installed).
- Base: `github/develop` at `2a008671c` (2026-10-19 18:38 CEST).
- Release line: `release/v0.2.0` at `8625a4a1b`. It carries the #5926 OCC worker split but **not** the Oct 14 UI-polish line.
- Live worker: `digithings-digichat`, last modified **2026-10-19 11:16Z**, container id **`shared-v15`**.
- Live stack: `digithings-stack`, last modified **2026-10-19 10:48Z**.

## What is live today

- `digithings-digichat` owns `/chat/occ*` (`occ-gate.ts`), `/api/mcp/zammad*` (gated by `x-digi-mcp-key` vs `ZAMMAD_EDGE_KEY`), `/api/chat*`, `/embed*`, `/_digichat/meta`, `/_digichat-admin/container/reset`.
- One container per worker (`DIGICHAT` Durable Object), tenant resolution from `DIGICHAT_EMBED_TENANTS`, `shared-<rev>` id derived from the deploying commit.
- The Zammad MCP moved **out of the base stack and into the digichat image** (`scripts/zammad_mcp`, spawned by `apps/digichat/scripts/trusted-proxy-server.mjs`, forwarded by `apps/digichat/src/app/api/mcp/zammad/[[...path]]/route.ts`).
- OCC system prompt lives in `apps/digithings-stack-cloudflare/wrangler.toml` (`DIGI_TENANT_CORPUS_MAP`, `vars`, ~line 306) with the identical fallback in `apps/digithings-stack-cloudflare/src/index.ts` (~line 133). It is consumed by digigraph via `digigraph/src/digigraph/corpus_routing.py`.

## Root cause of the regression

The OCC chat was developed on `DIG-OCC-ui-polish` (3 unique commits, 2026-10-14, never merged) on top of `DIG-3089-release-occ-chat`. When the Cloudflare work carved OCC out and re-cut the release, only the *tool-surface* fixes were carried over. The whole UX/behaviour line was left behind, so the live chat uses the older DigiChat surface.

Audit result (verified against `github/develop` by content, not ancestry):

| Branch | Status |
|---|---|
| `DIG-3089-release-occ-chat` | already in develop |
| `DIG-3269-occ-daily-index` | already in develop |
| `DIG-3355-...skills-and-workflows` | already in develop (develop newer) |
| `DIG-3576-occ-help-weekly-recrawl` | already in develop (byte-identical) |
| `DIG-3585-occ-edge-gate` | already in develop (byte-identical) |
| `DIG-3895/occ-corpus` | already in develop |
| `DIG-3394-remove-occ-client-chat-plan` | already in develop |
| `DIG-3578-occ-ticket-daily-refresh` | already in develop |
| **`DIG-OCC-ui-polish`** | **partially missing (~450 lines)** |
| **`occ/web-waking-boot-step`** | **one real gap: zammad MCP bare-Host matcher** |
| `DIG-3232-lane-3` commit `11e4e9afa` | unmerged: OCC prompt transcription in `contract.yaml` |

## Already done on `DIG-OCC-reconcile` (commit `af9c483dd`)

Ported and adapted to the current tool surface:

1. **Edit-in-composer** (`packages/ui/src/components/chat/gallery-thread/thread.aui.tsx`): edit loads the message into the main composer, resubmit replaces + regenerates, unchanged text is a no-op, Esc/exit/outside-click restores the draft.
2. **Per-tool session toggles**: `apps/digichat/src/components/stock/embed-composer-menu.tsx`, `embed-mcp-flow.ts`, `apps/digichat/src/lib/deploy-config/{client-projection,force-tool,schema,embed-bridge}.ts`, `apps/digichat/src/lib/{embed-client-config,embed-tenants}.ts`, `packages/ui/src/components/chat/stock/embed-chat-prefs.tsx`, `digigraph/src/digigraph/tool_policy.py`.
3. **Session house-model picker**: `apps/digichat/src/app/api/chat/route.ts`, `digigraph/src/digigraph/{model_config,server}.py`, `apps/digithings-stack-cloudflare/src/index.ts` (`DIGI_SESSION_MODEL_ALLOWLIST`).
4. Tests: `tests/dg/test_session_model_and_tool_toggles.py`.

Deliberately **not** ported because #5926 superseded them — do not re-add:
- `digisearchTools` / dedicated `digisearch_occ_help` + `digisearch_zammad_tickets` tools (measured dead on 2026-10-19; the callable semantic tool is `digisearch`, index forced server-side).
- `lockSessionControls` (inert on the live tenant map; separate change).
- the tenants-KV work (superseded by `TENANT_CONFIG`).

Verified on that commit: digichat `tsc` clean; 166 digichat tests, 29 UI thread tests, 11 composer/session tests, 3 digigraph tests green.

## Remaining work — do all of it, in this order

### 1. OCC prompt: merge the missing answer-quality rules

Source to port: `DIG-OCC-ui-polish`, prompt in `apps/digithings-stack-cloudflare/src/index.ts` (~line 138) / `wrangler.toml`.

Add these three paragraphs to the **current** prompt (do not replace the current grounding/ticket/skills text):

- **Language of shown terms** — translate every non-chat-language term shown in the answer (statuses, labels, titles, snippets, queries) as `translated term ("original")`; skip when the source is already in the chat language.
- **Citations** — no separate Sources list; inline markdown links only for http(s) URLs, otherwise a short parenthetical reference; never put `repo://` or vault paths in a link.
- **Identity** — you are the digichat assistant for Online Compliance Center; never claim to be Claude/GPT/DeepSeek or name a vendor; say the model is managed by the operator.

Do **not** port the branch's "Choosing a search tool" paragraph (it names the two dead tools).

Verify the grounding sentence against the **live tenant registry**. It currently says `digisearch_semantic`. That is a real MCP-prefixed name only if the OCC tenant attaches the digisearch MCP server; #5926 recorded the callable builtin as `digisearch`. Check the live `DIGICHAT_EMBED_TENANTS` OCC row (secret — read it with `wrangler secret` tooling, never paste it into this issue) and the tenant YAML, then make the prompt name exactly what the tenant can call. Record the evidence in a comment.

Apply the same text to every transcription so they cannot drift:
- `apps/digithings-stack-cloudflare/wrangler.toml` (`DIGI_TENANT_CORPUS_MAP`)
- `apps/digithings-stack-cloudflare/src/index.ts` (fallback)
- `config/contract/contract.yaml` + `config/contract/generated/wrangler.vars.digithings-stack.json` (include the unmerged `11e4e9afa` convergence work; it also fixes unrelated binding rows — keep those)
- `infra/digichat-release/compose.profile-a-bundle.override.yml`
- `infra/digichat-release/DIG-3556-staged-prod-tenant-config.json`
- update any byte-pinning tests (`tests/dg/test_corpus_routing.py`, `tests/scripts/test_check_tenant_corpus_map.py`, stack `tenant-config.test.ts`, etc.).

### 2. Zammad MCP bare-Host fix

`scripts/zammad_mcp/server.py:57` currently does:

```python
patterns.append(host if ":" in host else f"{host}:*")
```

so a portless edge `Host` (`digithings.ai`) never matches. From `occ/web-waking-boot-step` (`991068168`), the fix is:

```python
patterns.extend([host, f"{host}:*"])
```

Add a unit test for both a portless and a ported host. Check whether the Next forwarding route preserves the original `Host` and whether FastMCP even enforces the allowlist on the current mcp build (the docstring already flags builds that ignore it) — fix the matcher regardless.

### 3. Finish the reconciliation branch

- Rebase/merge `github/develop` into `DIG-OCC-reconcile`; keep the branch focused on OCC.
- Run the repo gates for touched surfaces: digichat vitest + tsc, packages/ui vitest, digigraph pytest (`tests/dg`), stack vitest + tsc, config contract tests.
- Open a PR into `develop`. Follow `pr-review-session` (Tuesday/Thursday batches; `develop` is agent-maintained). Do not promote to `main` without Chris's approval through One.

### 4. Cut a new digichat release with everything latest

Chris explicitly wants a **new digichat release**, not a hotfix on the old one. Follow `release-and-ops`:
- version bump from `apps/digichat/package.json` (currently `2.4.0`; latest tag is `digichat-v2.3.2`),
- release notes covering: OCC worker split, edit-in-composer, per-tool toggles, session model picker, prompt translation/citations/identity, zammad Host fix, tool-surface fixes,
- tag and publish the image/artifacts, and record the release ledger entry.

### 5. Deploy and verify live

Order matters: **stack first** (digigraph tool/model changes + prompt), **then** `digithings-digichat` (worker + container image), because the worker forwards to digigraph and digikey.

- Use `scripts/local-deploy/deploy_worker.sh <app> --live` (it runs the app's own `scripts/deploy.mjs`, packages image inputs, and builds the container locally first). Do not bypass the container-id derivation.
- The container only reads env at boot; recycle it via the sanctioned id bump/reset lever (`/_digichat-admin/container/reset`, `DIGICHAT_ADMIN_KEY`).
- Live checks after deploy, all must pass:
  - `GET /api/health` on `digithings.ai` → 200, `database: skipped`
  - `GET /chat/occ` without token → site 404; with a valid invite → 200
  - one real OCC chat turn that (a) calls a help-docs search, (b) calls a ticket tool (`zammad_search_tickets` / `zammad_list_tickets`), (c) renders inline citations, (d) shows the edit affordance and the per-tool toggles, (e) opens the model picker only if the tenant allows it
  - `/_digichat/meta` reports the container id derived from the deployed commit
  - no `Unknown tool`, `tool_not_allowed`, `502 upstream_auth`, `container_booting`
- Record the verification output in a comment. If a check fails, do not call it done.

## Sensitive-work constraints

- Client data. Never paste secrets, invite tokens, `DIGICHAT_EMBED_TENANTS`, `ZAMMAD_API_TOKEN`, `DIGIKEY_BFF_TOKEN` or customer content into this issue, a PR, a commit, or a log. Read secrets only through the sanctioned tooling.
- Do not widen the OCC corpus or the tenant allowlist.
- Do not re-add the base-stack DigiChat mount; OCC must stay on its own worker.
- Follow `digithings-operating-rules`, `digithings-brand`, `release-and-ops`, `pr-review-session`, `verification-before-completion`.

## Definition of done

1. The `DIG-OCC-reconcile` PR is merged to `develop` with all gates green.
2. A new digichat release exists, carrying the OCC improvements.
3. `digithings-stack` and `digithings-digichat` are deployed from that release, and the live checks above pass.
4. A comment on this issue records: PR link, release/tag, deploy timestamps, container id, and the chat transcript evidence for the five behaviours.
5. No follow-up work is left implicit — anything not done is filed as its own issue with an owner.
